name: YouTube
description: Turns any YouTube link into the urls a player needs: embed, watch, and thumbnail.

operations.name: youtube.parse
operations.description: Reads a YouTube link (watch, youtu.be, shorts, live, or a bare video id) and returns the embed url a video element plays, plus the watch and thumbnail urls.

inputs.name: url
inputs.description: A YouTube video link in any common form; t= timestamps carry over

outputs.name: embedUrl
outputs.description: The playable embed url; bind a video element's src to it

outputs.name: thumbnailUrl
outputs.description: A preview image url for an image element

outputs.name: startSeconds
outputs.description: Start position from the link's timestamp, 0 when none

operations.howto: Video player pattern: an input where the link is pasted, a Play button whose click runs youtube.parse with "url" bound to that input, and the "embedUrl" output routed to a state key a video element binds "src" from. The video element plays embed urls directly; a malformed link fails the operation with a readable message, so no extra checking is needed.
